reviews.text: I tried the Collagen Lifting Eye Cream by TIRTIR and it impressed me above all for the moisturizing and plumping effect on the eye contour. The texture is light but nourishing, absorbs well and the practical metallic applicator gives a pleasant fresh and lifting sensation. After a few weeks I noticed the more rested look, with the softer and smoother eye contour.
reviews.zh: 我試過 TIRTIR 嘅 Collagen Lifting Eye Cream，最令我印象深刻嘅係佢對眼周嘅保濕同飽滿效果。質地輕盈但滋養，吸收得好好，而且實用嘅金屬滾珠頭帶嚟清新同提拉嘅感覺，令人好舒服。用咗幾個星期之後，我覺得雙眼睇落更加精神，眼周都更軟滑、平滑。

reviews.text:
I already loved the packaging, but pro tip: keep it in the fridge before using it. It makes such a difference.

It really helps de-puff the under eyes, brightens those purple dark circles, and gives deep hydration. The cooling effect just makes everything feel more refreshed.

Such a good option if your under eyes need a boost ✨
reviews.zh:
我本身已經好鍾意個包裝，不過有個小貼士：用之前放入雪櫃。效果大不同。

佢真係幫手消腫，令紫色嘅黑眼圈變淡，同時深層保濕。涼感令成個人更加清新。

如果你嘅眼周需要提升，呢款係一個好好嘅選擇 ✨

reviews.text:
You need this! Hear me out… 

I was always lazy with eye cream. I realised one reason was because I hate putting my finger in a pot eye cream. This applicator is a game changer. It’s so cooling and pleasant to use. I find it de-puffs my eyes and soothes them. The eye cream is nice, but the applicator is amazing. I use half a pump on each eye and it dispenses so well. But the game changing part is that I have used this applicator to massage in other eye creams, as I also don’t want to run out. I now enjoy applying eye cream every day. 

🛍️ I’m repurchasing straight away.
reviews.zh:
你一定要試吓！聽我講……

我一直都好懶得搽眼霜。我發覺其中一個原因係我好憎用手指伸入罐裝眼霜入面。呢個滾珠頭改變咗一切。用落好清涼、好舒服。我覺得佢可以消腫、舒緩眼睛。眼霜都好好，但滾珠頭真係好正。我每邊眼用半下壓，出量都好均勻。不過最令我改變嘅係，我都用呢個滾珠頭將其他眼霜推開，因為我都唔想用完。而家我每日都好享受搽眼霜。

🛍️ 我即刻再買。

reviews.text: I wasn't that fond of the metal applicator when I first tried it but now it doesn't bother me at all. I'm 39 with fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes & I use this cream every night religiously alongside other anti-aging products. It softens the skin around the eyes & gives me a little pick-me-up that makes the aging process less visible, I'll definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh: 我第一次試嗰陣唔係好鍾意個金屬頭，但而家完全唔成問題。我 39 歲，眼周有幼紋同皺紋，我每晚都堅持搽呢款面霜，同其他抗老產品一齊用。佢令眼周皮膚變軟，又帶俾我少少提振嘅感覺，令衰老嘅痕跡冇咁明顯。我一定會再買。

reviews.text: Absolutely love this eye cream! It's become my go-to for reducing puffiness and fine lines around my eyes. The cooling sensation from the metal roller is incredibly refreshing and I've noticed a visible improvement in the texture and firmness of my under-eye area since using it. Plus, the collagen infusion feels luxurious and nourishing. Highly recommend for anyone looking to rejuvenate tired eyes!
reviews.zh: 我非常鍾意呢款眼霜！佢已經成為我減少眼周浮腫同細紋嘅首選。金屬滾珠帶嚟嘅清涼感覺好清新，而且自從用咗之後，我見到眼下位置嘅質地同緊緻度都有明顯改善。另外，膠原蛋白嘅滋養令人感覺好奢華。非常推薦畀任何想令疲倦雙眼恢復活力嘅人！

reviews.text: I have been using TIRTIR - Collagen Lifting Eye Cream Ginseng Renewing Eye Cream EX Mini for around 2 weeks. It is white lotion texture. There is no fragrance so it is natural. From the notes it said it can be applied not just skin under eyes but also the whole face to make skin firmer. So I just rolled it all over my face, it leaves my skin moisturized. Use its metal ball head to massage the face is quite comfortable.
reviews.zh: 我用咗 TIRTIR - Collagen Lifting Eye Cream Ginseng Renewing Eye Cream EX Mini 大約兩個星期。質地係白色乳液狀。冇香味，所以好天然。按照說明，可以唔止用喺眼下，全臉都可以用嚟令皮膚更緊緻。所以我就將佢滾遍成張面，之後皮膚都保持到水潤。用金屬滾珠頭按摩面部，都幾舒服。

reviews.text: It quickly became my favorite, I use it in the morning. The metal applicator is unique, you press and the flint comes out on the applicator and you apply it directly and you don't get dirty. I have fine lines around the eyes and it works well, does not grease absorbs quickly. Unique, I recommend
reviews.zh: 佢好快就成為我嘅最愛，我早上用。金屬塗抹頭好獨特，撳一下，眼霜就會出喺塗抹頭上，你直接搽就得，唔會弄污手。我眼周有幼紋，效果都好好，唔油膩，吸收得快。好獨特，我推薦。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
